# Scribus 1.6.1 feature-harvest fixtures

These are small documents saved by the exact Scribus build pinned by the
render image (`1.6.1-0ubuntu7`). They are evidence for the `0.2` compiler work,
not golden compiler output: Scribus allocates non-deterministic `ItemID` values
when the harvest is regenerated.

## Regenerate

From the repository root:

```bash
python3 services/render/tests/fixtures/scribus-1.6.1-features/make_assets.py \
  services/render/tests/fixtures/scribus-1.6.1-features/transparent-source.png

docker build -t ide8-render services/render

docker run --rm \
  -v "$PWD/services/render/tests/fixtures/scribus-1.6.1-features:/harvest" \
  ide8-render timeout 60s xvfb-run -a scribus -g -ns \
  -py /harvest/harvest_features.py \
  /harvest /harvest/transparent-source.png
```

`harvest_features.py` reopens and saves the gradient samples once before they
are committed. Scribus' scripting constants first emit legacy gradient codes
`1/5`; reopening normalises them to the round-trip-stable `6/7` codes.

## Verify

`verify_harvest.py` checks the exact mappings. `roundtrip_features.py` is run
inside Scribus against a temporary output directory; passing that directory to
the verifier proves that reopening/resaving preserves the relevant values.
The optional PPM arguments verify PDF paint order and transparent-PNG alpha.

The full command sequence and interpretation are recorded in
[`SCRIBUS-MAPPING.md`](../../../../../docs/briefs/byoma-pilot/SCRIBUS-MAPPING.md).

## Samples

- `linear-gradient.sla` — stable free linear gradient plus three stops.
- `radial-gradient.sla` — stable free radial gradient plus three stops.
- `radial-gradient-focal.sla` — non-centred item-local focal point.
- `object-opacity.sla` — 50% shape opacity.
- `opacity-calibration.sla` — non-symmetric 75% opacity calibration for fill
  and stroke.
- `image-opacity.sla` — 50% image opacity.
- `transparent-png.sla` — RGBA source over an opaque backing colour.
- `contain-image.sla` — manually centred proportional contain placement.
- `cover-focus-image.sla` — cover placement with an off-centre focal crop.
- `stretch-image.sla` — non-proportional frame fill.
- `filled-vector.sla` — filled and stroked custom vector geometry.
- `paint-order.sla` — three overlapping items proving document paint order.

`transparent-source.png` is synthetic and is regenerated byte-for-byte by
`make_assets.py`; it contains no brand or client material.
